archival_memory.user_introduction: Michael is a 35-year-old freelance graphic designer living in Seattle. He is interested in high-quality coffee machines that fit his design aesthetic and lifestyle. Michael has been researching and considering purchasing an espresso machine for some time, as he prefers the taste, temperature control, and café-like experience it offers. He is drawn to sleek, modern designs and wants to match the stainless steel finish of the machine to his kitchen's aesthetic.
